typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Copy of Period Counter Week} as integer,
		AgreementID as string,
		TradeID as string,
		ProductType as string,
		Tenor as string,
		CounterParty as string,
		XVATradeaID as string,
		Input as integer,
		NettingGroupID as string,
		Loaddate as string,
		WCISID as string,
		CptyHazardCurveCode as string,
		XVA_SCORE as string,
		{Copy of Period Counter Month} as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		Period_Counter_Week as integer,
		AgreementID as string,
		TradeID as string,
		ProductType as string,
		Tenor as string,
		CounterParty as string,
		XVATradeaID as string,
		Input as string,
		NettingGroupID as string,
		Loaddate as string,
		WCISID as string,
		CptyHazardCurveCode as string,
		XVA_SCORE as string,
		Period_Counter_Month as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Period_Counter_Week = {Copy of Period Counter Week},
		AgreementID,
		TradeID,
		ProductType,
		Tenor,
		CounterParty,
		XVATradeaID,
		Input,
		NettingGroupID,
		Loaddate,
		WCISID,
		CptyHazardCurveCode,
		XVA_SCORE,
		Period_Counter_Month = {Copy of Period Counter Month}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
